title: Translation decision memory contract
purpose: Future translation mode should compose from workbench-captured decisions and evidence instead of collecting new lexical, morphology, usage, or license data.
license_policy: Every decision row must keep source_rows for the source text and any definition, route, morphology, or usage evidence used. Imported copyrighted English translations are not allowed as evidence.
product_policy: Workbench mode may expose dense evidence. Translation mode will later filter by decision_status, license_safe, and evidence links.
source_anchor_policy: Every decision row must preserve a source_ref, unit_id, token_position, stable unit text hash, and W3C Web Annotation inspired text selectors. TextQuoteSelector exact/prefix/suffix is the portability anchor and should preserve the source text's own quote/geresh spelling; validators may normalize display-equivalent Hebrew quotes before comparing to surface_text. TextPositionSelector is useful but brittle and must be backed by the quote selector.
license_profile_policy: license_safe is only a workbench safety gate. license_profile.publication_class distinguishes publication_ok, publication_ok_with_attribution, workbench_ok_publication_review, and blocked_until_license_review. Future accepted translation rows may not rely on workbench_ok_publication_review or blocked_until_license_review sources for direct rendering unless a separate output-license decision exists.
translation_safe_rendering_rule: Only decision_status=accepted, license_safe=true, and license_profile.direct_translation_use_ok=true rows may be used directly by a future translation renderer. Candidate and ambiguous rows may be shown in workbench mode but require review before translation publication.
workbench_display_rule: Workbench mode may show accepted, candidate, ambiguous, and needs_review rows if each row is visibly labeled by decision_status and evidence type.

source_rows.notes: Coordination contract only. No external translation text is imported.
